scenes.vo: This morning, a note slid under my door. It said rule four.
Someone always has to be in 9C. Below that: If nobody is, 9C comes LOOKING.
I grabbed my boxes and ran down the stairs, all the way to the street. I looked back. EIGHT floors.
I found a new place across the city. Apartment 4B. Cheap and bright. I slept all night.
On the second night, I checked my door. The brass plate didn't say 4B anymore. It said 9C.
Then my clock turned to three AM. Knock. Knock. Knock.
